_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S8 (Thule). Sourced 2026-07-05. Thule Sleek in DOUBLE mode (same frame as thule-sleek, configured for a sibling/second car seat). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Thule Sleek (Double Mode)

clekListed.clekRow: Thule Sleek (Double Mode) — Thule Sleek car seat adapter for Maxi-Cosi (11000300 x2) & Thule Sleek adapter kit (11000326)

specs._weightNote: Base frame 27.9 lb; the second/sibling seat adds weight (exact double-mode combined weight not separately published by Thule) → treat 27.9 as the frame baseline.
specs._unfoldedNote: Same 116 x 61 x 85 cm frame footprint as single mode; the second seat stacks vertically, so width (24 in) is unchanged in double mode.

brake.type: one-step foot-operated rocker parking brake (flip-flop friendly)

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (with infant car seat/bassinet); main seat 0–36 mo, second seat 0–30 mo

safety.standards: Meets US ASTM F833 stroller standard — Clek's list confirms the Sleek (incl. double mode) was tested with the Liing and is ASTM-compliant for car seats on strollers.

recall.summary: Same frame as thule-sleek: Thule recalled ~4,000 US (plus ~880 Canada) Sleek strollers (CPSC, 2020) because the handlebar can detach (injury hazard). Affects Sleek units WITHOUT a 'QC2020' sticker manufactured May 2018-Sept 2019; remedy was a free replacement Sleek stroller frame. A separate 2020 recall covered the Thule Sleek Maxi-Cosi car seat adapter 11000301 (fall hazard); the adapters used here are 11000300 + kit 11000326.

safety.notes: Main seat 48.5 lb / 22 kg, second seat 33 lb / 15 kg; 5-point harnesses; auto-lock fold latch. Double-mode car seat use requires the Sleek adapter kit (11000326) plus the Maxi-Cosi car seat adapter (11000300).

specs.foldType: one-hand compact fold, self-standing with auto-lock
specs.strollerType: urban / convertible double (sibling stroller, up to 3 kids across configs)
specs.recline: multi-position (3-position) recline to near-flat on both seats
specs.tires: front EVA foam-coated swivel/lockable wheels (~8 in); rear foam-filled puncture-free wheels (~11 in)

notes: Same physical stroller as thule-sleek, configured for two children. To run a Clek Liing in double mode you need the Sleek adapter kit 11000326 (adapter-11000326) plus the Maxi-Cosi car seat adapter 11000300 (adapter-11000300) — per Clek's own list. Second-seat/sibling config raises the price to ~$1,229.90 (Thule MSRP). A vertical-stack sibling stroller, not a side-by-side; footprint width stays at 24 in.
